h1: When can a Newton homeowner pull their own building permit?
title: Massachusetts Homeowner Permit Exemption: What Owner-Occupants Should Know
description: Learn the distinction between a homeowner's building-code licensing exemption and the separate requirement to obtain permits.
short_answer: Massachusetts building-code rules provide a homeowner exemption from certain construction-supervisor licensing requirements when the homeowner performs the work and supervises hired workers. This is not a general exemption from building permits or other safety requirements. Newton homeowners should confirm permit eligibility and the HIC Guaranty Fund consequences before applying in their own name.

facts.text: The Massachusetts construction-supervisor licensing regulation contains an exemption for a homeowner performing work for which a building permit is required, subject to the stated supervision conditions.
Massachusetts says a homeowner who applies for the building permit may not be eligible for compensation from the HIC Guaranty Fund.

qa.q: Does the homeowner exemption mean I can do regulated work without a building permit?
qa.a: No. The exemption concerns construction-supervisor licensing; it does not eliminate the underlying building permit or applicable code requirements.
